name: Tella
tagline: Simple screen and camera recording for polished async videos

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Pro listed at $13/month and Premium at $19/month.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.limits: Unlimited videos; clips up to 6 hours; 106 languages; 4K; 60fps export only for videos up to 5 minutes

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.limits: Custom domain, domain restriction, white-labeling, 60fps and advanced analytics

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.limits: Custom seats, SSO/SCIM, security, support and procurement

pricing.freeTierCaps: no free tier; 7-day workspace trial allows unlimited recording, editing, export and sharing, but blocks uploads of existing videos and raw-recording export
pricing.billingTerms: monthly + annual (50% lower); plan changes are prorated
pricing.hiddenCosts: SSO/SCIM is an add-on on self-serve paid plans and included only with Enterprise; every user requires a paid seat.

verdictSummary: For solo async clips, a recorder plus lightweight trimming and hosted share page can be vibecoded; the paid app wins on design polish and templates.
coreLoopDIY: Record screen/webcam, combine tracks, trim, render, upload, and generate a clean share page.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because they want a video that looks good without editing or deployment chores.

priorArt.name: OBS Studio
priorArt.desc: Can cover the recording layer; a vibecoded clone would add opinionated hosting and layouts

alternatives.name: Recordly
alternatives.desc: Polished screen-and-camera recordings with auto-zoom and editing; still visibly young around audio.

alternatives.name: Screenity
alternatives.desc: A browser extension that records forever, edits enough, then hands you a file or Drive link.

rejectedAlternatives.name: OBS Studio
rejectedAlternatives.desc: Powerful capture, but the simple polishing and async-video workflow are yours to assemble.

notes: More attainable than Loom; good 'yes but you lose polish' entry.
prompt:
Build me a screen recorder with share pages to replace Tella. Requirements:

- A local web page (Node + Express on localhost:4600) using getDisplayMedia +
  getUserMedia: record screen and webcam together, webcam as a circular overlay in
  the bottom-left, captured with MediaRecorder to webm.
- After recording, a trim step: set in/out points on a simple timeline, preview,
  then render the final 1080p H.264 MP4 with ffmpeg.
- One-click publish: rsync the MP4 to my VPS, where a tiny share app serves
  /v/<id>, a page with the player, title, and my name. Copy the URL to my clipboard.
- Share page extras: a poster frame extracted with ffmpeg for the og:image tag, and
  a view counter in SQLite. Nothing else on the page.
- Keep originals and renders in ~/Recordings/YYYY-MM-DD-<title>/.
- No accounts, no telemetry; the share pages are the only public surface.
- Out of scope: layout templates, zoom/pan effects, and a team library. Trim only,
  this is not an editor.
- README: browser screen-capture permissions, ffmpeg install, VPS + Caddy snippet
  for the share domain.
